name: Callejear France
description: Search French communes and street records, retrieve IRIS-level BPE amenity counts and commune-level GASPAR codes, and compare 2–5 streets with five read-only tools. Snapshot: 2,192,808 street records across 101 departments. Missing values and unavailable source dates remain explicit; these are not walking-radius counts or parcel-level risk assessments. Free without an account or API key; 30 tool calls/minute and 100/day per origin, with 1,000/day globally.
